LESSON: INDIGENOUS KENYAN GAMES (OPTIONAL)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.6: Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional), part of Performing and Displaying in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: How do indigenous animal games enhance physical fitness? 2. Why are indigenous animal games considered an indigenous?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Indigenous Kenyan Games (Optional) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner takes on different roles while playing animal games.

• Unity: The learner works with others while playing animal games.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety: The learner observes safety rules when playing animal games.

• Health and Fitness: The learner improves fitness when playing animal games for a healthy lifestyle.

Link to other learning areas:

• Mathematics: The learner keeps counting during animal games.

• Agriculture and Nutrition: The learner's knowledge of different animals is enhanced.
